## Checklist

Pull requests are accepted only if they meet [docs/STANDARDS.md](https://github.com/AadeshGurav/Fast-API-Boiler-Plate/blob/develop/docs/STANDARDS.md),
whoever or whatever wrote them.

- [ ] Meets the standards, including the definition of done
- [ ] `make test` and `make lint` pass
- [ ] Tests cover the new behaviour, including failure branches
- [ ] Docs updated in this PR (`make config-docs` if settings changed)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry under *Unreleased* for user-visible changes
- [ ] Code graph refreshed (`make graph` or the post-commit hook)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or personal data
